snippet.title: Anima Shin Gun - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2840820/Anima_Shin_Gun/?beta=0

Anima Shin gun is a Bullet Hell Rail Shooter where you GET SHOT TO SURVIVE.
Engage enemies and absorb their bullets as “seconds of life” by switching to the right color frequency. Thus, surviving long enough to break the time loop you’re trapped in and complete the ENTIRE adventure before the countdown reaches zero.
